gt_summary: Curved allometry: log10(B) = C0 + C1*(log10(M)-3) + C2*(log10(M)-3)^2, i.e. quadratic in log-mass with mass-varying local exponent.
submission_summary: Standard Kleiber power law: log10(B) = 0.76*log10(M) - 1.71, i.e. linear in log-mass with fixed exponent.
matched: Correct outer family: linear combination in log10(M) space (allometric scaling)
Reasonable slope (~0.76) consistent with GT's C1 (~0.73)
missed: Missing quadratic curvature term C2*(log10(M)-3)^2 which is the key GT correction distinguishing it from standard Kleiber's law
No mass-varying local exponent; submission assumes constant exponent
coefficient_assessment: Linear term slope (0.76) and intercept (-1.71) are reasonable for a linearized version of the GT, but the missing C2 curvature term is the defining structural feature of the GT mechanism.
